speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Spire Sentinel neutralized. Summit catwalk secured. Pressure is stabilizing at the Cyber-Nexus intake.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Spire Sentinel neutralized. Summit catwalk secured. Pressure is stabilizing at the Cyber-Nexus intake.

speaker: TITAN
text: My boots are still humming from that climb. And now an airlock built to survive bombardment. Of course.
subtitle: TITAN: My boots are still humming from that climb. And now an airlock built to survive bombardment. Of course.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: Look down through the haze. No shield over the skyline. The city is awake. Remember who we are doing this for.
subtitle: OCEANUS: Look down through the haze. No shield over the skyline. The city is awake. Remember who we are doing this for.

speaker: SURYA
text: The Nexus is still running. Leave its factories online, and they can rebuild that defense grid within hours.
subtitle: SURYA: The Nexus is still running. Leave its factories online, and they can rebuild that defense grid within hours.

speaker: AURA
text: I can feel it through the deck. So many linked processors. A hive of stolen signals behind one bulkhead.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: Terminal override accepted. Security is folding. Stand clear. The pressure seal is breaking.
subtitle: MIRAGE: Terminal override accepted. Security is folding. Stand clear. The pressure seal is breaking.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Atmospheric purge complete. Intake airlock opening. Quantum mainframe chambers confirmed beyond the threshold.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Atmospheric purge complete. Intake airlock opening. Quantum mainframe chambers confirmed beyond the threshold.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: Optical conduits, floating prisms, laser baffles. A whole labyrinth. We will have to watch every step.
subtitle: MIRAGE: Optical conduits, floating prisms, laser baffles. A whole labyrinth. We will have to watch every step.

speaker: KAITO
text: Then we tread carefully and strike deep. Silence the Nexus core. Axiom Force, through the airlock.
